cohort: The cohort consisted of 390 mothers, with 130 mothers who delivered preterm (28-36 weeks gestation) and 260 mothers who delivered at term (37-42 weeks gestation) at Greater Accra Regional Hospital.
finding: Premature rupture of membrane, pre-eclampsia/eclampsia, hypertensive complications, and antepartum haemorrhage were identified as risk factors for preterm delivery, while four or more antenatal care visits were found to be a protective factor.
